question: Summarize the Orion Systems MSA redlines

intro.title: The docket opens
intro.text: Mediacorp Legal, Friday August 8. Sofia Reyes's day arrives as a court docket — pleading caption, rubber stamps, numbered entries. One matter headlines: Orion Systems.

hero.title: In re: Orion Systems
hero.text: A pleading caption for the $1.24M MSA, a stamp still reading Pending sign-off, the 1×→2× cap counter, and a live countdown to the 10:30 call.

kpis.title: The record, certified
kpis.text: Four naked figures from source systems: 38 contracts in review, 6.8-day turnaround, 72.4% NDAs auto-cleared, 54 matters open. Sparklines carry the trend.

chart.title: No. 01 — Exhibits
chart.text: Exhibit A, the full-width joined record: July intake spiked to 138, completions hit 135. Exhibit B enters the finding — the backlog barely moved.

ask.title: Interrogate the docket
ask.text: Sofia drags the Orion caption itself into chat and asks askMElah to summarize the MSA redlines — 18 edits, only 3 material.

delegate.title: No. 02 — Filings
delegate.text: Cross-app filings run numbered workflows end to end; the clerk's office hands routine matters to askMElah, who reports back done — no chasing, no tabs.

autopilot.title: Ink without the wait
autopilot.text: Flip Autopilot on the For-signature docket: low-risk instruments like Latham's data-room access thud down APPROVED stamps. The $1,240,000 Orion exception still waits for Sofia's pen.

mcp.title: Of record, wired in
mcp.text: The footer lists counsel of record: DocuSign, SharePoint, Confluence, Outlook, Teams, Slack, Drive — seven live MCP connections, certified by askMElah, clerk of record.

recap.title: Draft my end-of-week recap
recap.text: One hero button and the week writes itself: queue held at 38, 23 renewals tracked, board litigation summary drafted before Priya's Tuesday deadline.

outro.title: Counsel, amplified
outro.text: Same Sofia, same judgment — the docket just keeps itself. Mediacorp's legal team scales on askMElah's clerking, not on headcount.
